'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Angelo Consoli DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Deck title Rall Ops. Sergeant Major Bussh → Blash (V). Insignificant Rebellion without (V) on sheet.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Angelo Consoli]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
